description: Translates one received text, website chat or email into the business language, as tapping Translate under it does, and saves the translation on the message (a repeat returns the saved translation with no new AI call). kind 'email' for an email, a text or chat otherwise. Nothing is sent and the original is never changed. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: translate_message
title: Translate a received message
